# Quantum Metric Subprocessor List

Updated onOct 9, 2026

Quantum Metric may engage Subprocessors to Process Personal Data and assist in providing the Quantum Service. This page provides relevant information about each Subprocessor. Capitalized terms used but not defined on this page have the meanings set forth in the [SaaS End-User License Agreement (EULA)](https://iam.quantummetric.com/terms-and-conditions).
